title: Generation intent (phase 06)
description: What a natural-language instruction may change. Every parameter is optional (null = not requested) and maps to one validated configuration field. Area, coordinates, sources, performance limits and the export adapter cannot be expressed here.

facade_detail.description: Requested facade detail. Recorded in project quality.detail_level.

residential_levels.description: Estimated storeys of multi-storey residential buildings without observed data (heights typical_levels.residential_multi).

interior_buildings.description: Maximum buildings with a simplified interior (detail interiors.max_buildings). 0 disables interiors.

performance_priority.description: max: refuse any change that adds cost beyond the configuration measured on the Quest. balanced: allow it with a warning.

unsupported_requests.description: Parts of the instruction that were not mapped to a parameter.
